name: Report / Statement
constraints: WM-REC-002 owns stable report-definition identity and immutable definition versions.
Each report issue pins one exact definition version and validated parameter binding.
Input snapshots, partitions, digests and execution evidence are immutable issue evidence.
Reporting period, cutoff, as-of basis and issue time remain distinct.
Asserted grain cannot exceed the applicable disclosure shape.
Suppression records policy version and reason without leaking withheld values.
Correction or changed input creates a successor issue and never overwrites an issued statement.
Restatement lineage is acyclic and has one current head per definition, parameter set and period.
Issue, processing run, record artifact, publication case and edition use disjoint identifiers.
Publication never implies issue validity and issue validity never implies publication.
A live dashboard view is ephemeral; only a frozen citable snapshot becomes a report issue.
Explanation evidence remains resolvable throughout record retention.
